record_notes.DCP-LETT-349: Declines an unlocated Babbage invitation. Address gives a broad 1837-1838 window; shell comparison is social prose, not a dated knowledge exchange.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-358: Lyell wrote last week about forwarding Whewell History to Babbage after misunderstanding the Scotland request. Full readings of 343 and 376 do not locate that request. Preserve June-September interval; no exact receipt day or matched prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-377A: Publisher plan follows an interview. Its transmission and use in 378A were already adjudicated in batch-07; do not duplicate that knowledge edge.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-351: Thanks Babbage for repeated party cards and declines. Watermark and address support the broad 1838 interval, not a particular Wednesday. No surviving card matched.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-357: Asks Babbage to carry a parcel to Henslow. 400 explicitly uses Babbage as bearer and asks Henslow to forward a volcanic rock to Miller. Both are outgoing; this is a relay relationship, not an incoming prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-476: Apologizes for asking to bring a friend and then being too ill to attend. Broad 1839-August 1842 interval. Similar social notes 470, 479 and 474 do not identify this invitation or its order.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-470: Requests permission for Miss Allen to accompany Mrs Darwin and Darwin. Corrects Luna summary that substituted his brother and illness from another record. No surviving invitation input.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-479: Requests permission for his sister to accompany him. Sister identity is unspecified; only the nineteenth day and broad February 1839-August 1842 interval are established.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-517: Treasury payment notification follows the accounts sent in 512A, but the actual incoming notice is unlocated. Folthorp account annotations are not Darwin prose. Andrew Smith number 5 is a separate publication query.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-474: Declines because of health and Emma being unwell, asks whether his sister may go with Erasmus tomorrow. Broad Friday interval retained; no invitation matched.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-553: States he did not read the publisher note yesterday because he was ill. This supports non-reading on February 5 and response by February 6, not an exact February 5 receipt. Sends a manuscript sample and asks price per thousand words; note unlocated.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-570: Asks permission to bring the Sismondis and Miss Allen; sisters have left town. Later use of the London house does not prove attendance at this proposed visit.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-629A: Reconstructed surviving text clarifies private copies and an unlocated earlier publisher exchange. Mentions a copy for Dr Allan of Forres, but Malcolmson letters do not uniquely establish this particular instruction. Preserve differing private-copy totals in annotations.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-658: Requests an account and directs Bell and Hinds business. Manuscript inspection and Bell illness may be oral knowledge; no matched incoming letter.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-659: Acknowledges an account, not necessarily a covering letter. Follows 658 through the intervening account; two outgoing letters are not a direct training pair.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-677A: Requests shipment of two pamphlets to an unidentified Massachusetts professor. Hitchcock is an editorial possibility; no particular recipient or reply input established.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-702: Acknowledges box information and says the account has already been forwarded to Treasury. 702A is the same-day account submission. Record the completed action before this paragraph without inventing posting order. Volcanic Islands is still nearly ready for press.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-709: Treasury is ready to pay the final account, but the notification itself is unlocated. 702A establishes the outgoing claim, not the content of a surviving incoming prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-343: Additional full reading: Lyell coral discussion and invitation; does not contain the Whewell book request in 358.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-376: Additional full reading: Lyell geological and Beck classification discussion; does not locate the Whewell book request.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-401: Additional full reading: Gould specimen correspondence, not the Babbage-Henslow parcel in 357.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-400: Additional full reading: Henslow letter explicitly sent by Babbage, requests forwarding a volcanic rock to Miller, Canaries book access, and publication assistance. Supports parcel relay with 357, not a reply pair.
